bagPolicy.summary: X-Ray Arcade hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: There is plenty of street parking on Packard and Martin with curb cuts. The venue is also on MCTS Bus Route 15, with the closest stop at Packard and Pulaski.
parking.quote: There is ample street parking on Packard and Martin with cut-curb access.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by X-Ray Arcade. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Pizza bagels and fried snacks lead the menu, with vegan and vegetarian options. The full bar has domestic and rotating craft beers, cocktails, hard seltzers, wine and non-alcoholic drinks.
concessions.quote: Pizza bagels and fried snacks headline our menu of food designed for the overgrown child that you are.

accessibility.summary: X-Ray Arcade is general admission standing room, but reserved ADA seating is available on request. The main entrance has three stairs with a handrail, and there is ramp access on Martin Avenue and to the patio; call ahead if you need wheelchair access. Restrooms are accessible, and you can request accommodations at info@xrayarcade.com, 414-998-0665, or with any staff member.
accessibility.quote: X-Ray Arcade is a General Admission standing-room venue, but reserved ADA seating can be provided upon request.

reEntry.summary: X-Ray Arcade hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: X-Ray Arcade hasn't published box office and will call details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

gates.summary: The venue opens at the door time listed on its calendar. The main entrance has three stairs with a handrail, and a ramp entrance is on Martin Avenue.
gates.quote: There are three stairs with a handrail to enter via the main entrance.
